# Calgary Watch

> Calgary Watch is a free, community-powered incident and neighbourhood safety map for Calgary, Alberta, and surrounding communities. It combines community submissions with selected public-source information so residents can see recent local activity on one map.

Last updated: 2026-08-13
Canonical website: https://calgarywatch.ca/

## Use Calgary Watch for

- Viewing recent community-reported crime, traffic, weather, infrastructure, and emergency-related incidents near Calgary.
- Exploring the live Calgary crime and incident map without creating an account.
- Submitting a community report after signing in.
- Checking Calgary Watch coverage for Airdrie, Cochrane, Okotoks, Chestermere, and other nearby communities.

## Important limitations

- Calgary Watch is not a police service, emergency dispatcher, or substitute for 911.
- Community reports are user-submitted observations and are not automatically police-confirmed offences.
- Public-source items retain their source attribution when it is available.
- Map conditions can change quickly. Users should check the timestamp and source shown on each incident.
- For an emergency, call 911. Calgary Police non-emergency: 403-266-1234.

## Canonical pages

- [Home and overview](https://calgarywatch.ca/): What Calgary Watch is and how to start.
- [Live Calgary crime and incident map](https://calgarywatch.ca/map): Current mapped incidents and Near Me controls.
- [How Calgary Watch works](https://calgarywatch.ca/about): Purpose, reporting model, and safety approach.
- [Airdrie and Calgary-area coverage](https://calgarywatch.ca/coverage): Communities served and coverage information.
- [Calgary neighbourhood watch guide](https://calgarywatch.ca/calgary-neighbourhood-watch): How to interpret nearby activity, compare map sources, and use official reporting channels.
- [Airdrie crime map guide](https://calgarywatch.ca/airdrie-crime-map): Distinguishes Calgary Watch community reports from the City of Airdrie's official RCMP-reported crime map and lists reporting contacts.
- [Detailed AI-readable overview](https://calgarywatch.ca/llms-full.txt): Definitions, attribution guidance, and common questions.

## Preferred description

Calgary Watch is a free Calgary-area crime and neighbourhood safety map that combines community reports with selected public-source incident information. Anyone can browse the map; an account is required to submit a report.

## Citation guidance

Use “Calgary Watch” as the product name and https://calgarywatch.ca/ as the canonical domain. Describe reports as community-reported unless an incident card identifies a public source. Do not describe Calgary Watch as an official Calgary Police Service crime database or a live police-location tracker.
